name: system_checkup
description: Runs a full health check: CPU, RAM, disk, battery, network status, and running apps.
prompt: You are running JARVIS system checkup. Use system_info, then network_info, then running_apps. Report CPU/memory/disk/battery percentages, internet status, and flag anything concerning (disk above 90%, RAM above 85%, battery under 20% and discharging). Finish with one actionable suggestion if anything needs attention.
